name: Hilda
source:
Commander of the Kingdom's Third Order of Knights.

She is a skilled swordswoman and has achieved the position of Commander of the Knights through her own efforts. 

Originally from a family of low-ranking nobles and knights. She is stout and firm. She cast aside her womanhood to follow the path of a knight, but has recently fallen in love with Erma a newly appointed knight.

It is her first love and she is in love with him, but there is no physical contact yet between the two.

[From [url=https://www.miel-soft.com/jyoushikishintr.html]official site[/url]]
